extension.description: The Nightcity skin in a quiet look: a centred spotlight, posters in calm rows, a soft glow on focus, colour themes and rounded buttons, with online movie and TV data from TMDb Helper.

Der Nightcity-Skin in ruhigem Look: ein mittiges Spotlight, Poster in ruhigen Reihen, ein sanftes Leuchten im Fokus, Farbschemata und runde Schaltflächen, mit Online-Daten zu Filmen und Serien von TMDb Helper.

Le skin Nightcity dans un style apaisé : une mise en avant centrée, des affiches en lignes sobres, une douce lueur sur la sélection, des thèmes de couleur et des boutons arrondis, avec les données en ligne des films et séries de TMDb Helper.

El skin Nightcity con un aspecto sereno: un destacado centrado, pósteres en filas tranquilas, un brillo suave en el foco, temas de color y botones redondeados, con datos en línea de películas y series de TMDb Helper.

La skin Nightcity in un aspetto sobrio: una vetrina centrata, locandine in righe ordinate, un leggero bagliore sul focus, temi di colore e pulsanti arrotondati, con dati online su film e serie TV da TMDb Helper.

A skin Nightcity em um visual sereno: um destaque centralizado, pôsteres em linhas tranquilas, um brilho suave no foco, temas de cores e botões arredondados, com dados online de filmes e séries do TMDb Helper.

Skórka Nightcity w spokojnym wydaniu: wyśrodkowana sekcja wyróżnionych, plakaty w spokojnych rzędach, delikatna poświata na zaznaczeniu, motywy kolorów i zaokrąglone przyciski, z danymi online o filmach i serialach z TMDb Helper.
Nightcityスキンを静かな外観にしたものです。中央のスポットライト、静かに並ぶポスター、フォーカス時のやわらかな光、カラーテーマ、角の丸いボタンを備え、TMDb Helperによるムービーとテレビ番組のオンライン情報も表示します。
extension.news: 0.1.3 - All movies and all shows can be shown as a list: a Details button picks what a row shows (year, runtime, rating, resolution, HDR, audio; for shows seasons, episodes, studio), sorting adds runtime, and a filter narrows the list by genre, resolution, HDR, audio format, channels and studio. The music library has a genre filter.[CR]On Deck: continue watching and next up in one row, now the first row of home and shows.[CR]A still spotlight shows the title Down would land on, with its buttons; a spotlight switched off is gone. Movies have their own spotlight interval.[CR]Trailers come from IMDb in the best quality, without the YouTube add-on.[CR]The home page can be hidden like the other pages; the Home key goes to the first page shown.[CR]The current episode of an episode page has the focus frame without the glow.[CR]The filter dialogs have one OK, Left goes up a level, Right enters a group.[CR]Back held in the player's chapter and cast rows goes back to the controls.[CR]Icons keep their shape on screens that are not 16:9.[CR]The row Unwatched is gone: new movies and new episodes have it as option, and set rows move over by themselves.[CR]The small glitches are down to the loading screen, without a setting.[CR]0.1.2 - Confuse now speaks German, French, Spanish, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Polish and Japanese. For Japanese choose the font Arial under Settings, Interface, Skin, Fonts: it is Kodi's own font with Japanese letters.[CR]Small glitches: now and then the loading spinner sticks or runs backwards, the logo shivers, the spotlight tears for a blink and some titles twitch when they get the focus. The switch is under Appearance in the skin settings.[CR]The buttons of an info page have room for every language: the last one was cut off in German.[CR]0.1.1 - A new look for Home: the tabs in the middle, the spotlight as a large sharp picture, continue and next up as wide cards with the art of the film or show, posters in every other row.[CR]A logo of its own, also as the icon, and a quiet loading page with the logo and a spinner.[CR]The fades over the spotlight and the player controls are lighter, a focused card glows, and the glow of a focused tab is no longer cut off.[CR]The subtitle and audio delay can be set again in the player.[CR]0.1.0 - First version of Confuse: the Nightcity skin in a calm look with a glowing ember focus and colour themes.
